name: Blood Wraith buffs Wraithblade's weapon damage and Runic Power cost (#3122)
contract: Spell 707305 (Blood Wraith) carries two native SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER effects, family 36,
classmask 2, matching Wraithblade's (805258 and ranks) own SpellFamilyFlags[0] = 2:
SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 (op 23, BasePoints 99 -> +100) on Wraithblade's weapon-percent-damage effect, and
SPELLMOD_COST (op 14, BasePoints -201 -> -200) on its Runic Power cost.
Both ops are applied generically by the core (Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers dispatches SPELLMOD_EFFECT3
for effect index 2; SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost applies SPELLMOD_COST), so no CoA script is required:
learning the passive talent alone should move both modifiers.

steps.label: SETUP: no effect-3 modifier on Wraithblade before learning the talent
SETUP: no cost modifier on Wraithblade before learning the talent
Blood Wraith adds a flat +100 modifier to Wraithblade's weapon-damage effect
Blood Wraith reduces Wraithblade's Runic Power cost by 200
